bundle: P3 ApJS v3.1.161 machine-readable submission tables
scope: Validated DESI+SDSS+geometry-gated-NEOWISE point-source product, released archival Planck cross-transfer diagnostic, merged continuity catalog, and cross-survey coincidence table. This is not a complete six-survey native-data package.

excluded_or_unavailable.lamost_dr10: No released per-object table; aggregate/dedup contribution is exploratory and fails the detector-sensitivity gate.
excluded_or_unavailable.planck_native: Native checkpoint, 200000-patch tensor, full score bank, and native top-200 table are unavailable; the bundled Planck table is the archival cross-transfer diagnostic.
excluded_or_unavailable.erosita_dr1: Separate membership-only addendum, outside the scoped ApJS machine-readable table package.
excluded_or_unavailable.gaia_dr3: Synthetic historical placeholder, quarantined and excluded from all reported counts.
excluded_or_unavailable.act_dr6: Cross-transfer historical artifact, quarantined and excluded from all reported counts.

files.role: Validated fixed-size SDSS continuity slice; not a uniform physical threshold.
Raw top-1-percent NEOWISE table; the documented ecliptic-pole mask retains 419 rows.
Archival 20000-patch cross-transfer diagnostic, not the unavailable native top-200.
Merged continuity catalog; excluding ACT, Gaia, and eROSITA yields 377482 rows, comprising 377282 point sources plus 200 archival Planck patches.

submission_note: The Parquet payloads are intentionally gitignored; this tracked manifest makes the local bundle auditable and reproducible from the immutable source revision. Do not describe this package as containing native LAMOST or native Planck row-level products.
